19	## 0. THE SUBJECT MATTER IN ONE PARAGRAPH
20	
21	All six retellings concern the **Larrow Valley Cooperative Creamery Association** and its
22	**skimming station at Ostrey Hollow**, seven miles up the valley from the main creamery at
23	**Larrow Green**, in a valley whose county seat/office town is **Ashlin**. For roughly a quarter
24	century the milk of the Ostrey Hollow farmers tested lower for butterfat than their neighbors'
25	milk. This produced: a circular letter in 1919 accusing nine families of watering their cans; a
26	patrons' petition and board of arbitration in 1925 that found "no cause established" yet awarded
27	money anyway and put the tester out; and, in 1958–59, a granddaughter's demonstration that the
28	real cause was a crate of short-measuring glass pipettes. The six sources disagree with each
29	other — and in places with themselves — on numbers, dates, kinship, and blame. Those conflicts
30	are listed in Section 7 and are the most important part of these notes.
